newsitem.title: UK: Azlan sees yr profits at 14.8 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Azlan sees yr profits at 14.8 mln stg.

text.p: British computing products and services distributor Azlan Group Plc said on Monday that pre-tax profits for the year to April 5, 1997, were expected to be in line with expectations at around 14.8 million stg, up from 10.5 million a year earlier.
Azlan said sales were expected to rise to around 280 million stg from 196 million a year earlier.
In constant currency terms and excluding the initial contribution from newly-acquired Dutch computer training company Akam, the company said organic sales growth exceeded 37 percent.
Azlan also said it had appointed Peter Bertram as group finance director.
